messages:
Maria: hey team — Zephyrus sent a security questionnaire and they asked for a short pre-call pack. main asks: KMS/BYOK flow + rotation without downtime, audit log retention & export for private deployments, and RBAC change attestations for tenant migration. call is tomorrow 09:30 PT. can we collate quick answers and evidence?

Sam: pls paste the exact snippets they sent so we don't guess.

Maria: here are the excerpts they highlighted:

> 1) Describe envelope encryption: who holds KEK/DEK, how rotation works, can we rotate customer-provided KEK without downtime?
> 2) Audit logs: retention policy, tamper-evidence, export formats, and sample log entries for access to tenant data.
> 3) RBAC/migration: provide signed changelog or attestation for role changes when moving tenant to Dedicated.

Rohit: short answers first — we use envelope encryption. customer KEK (BYOK) stays in their KMS/HSM. we encrypt model/tenant DEKs with that KEK. we don't store raw KEKs. rotation is supported via re-encrypt-of-DEK; if they want zero-downtime we can do rolling rewraps (background rewrap + dual-read of old/new for a TTL). will draft a diagram.

Olivia: for logs — hosted default retention 90d, Dedicated 365d, Private: configurable (we usually recommend >= 1yr for enterprise). exports supported to S3, GCS, or syslog/HTTPS ingest. logs are JSONL with per-request context and hashing for tamper-evidence. sample line: 

```
{"ts":"2025-11-02T17:04:12Z","tenant":"zephyrus","actor":"svc-migration","action":"key_rewrap","result":"success","request_id":"req-88a3"}
```

Jake: RBAC changes — ops run migrations using time-limited service accounts (60m max) scoped to migration namespace. every role grant/revoke emits an audit event and we can sign the changelog with our enterprise signing key (FAQ: we provide a signed bundle in the evidence packet). we also support a delegated approval workflow (2 approvers) for high-privilege changes.

Maria: Q from Zephyrus: do we maintain a proof-of-rotation that they can ingest into their SIEM? (they want a signed artifact showing KEK swap).

Rohit: yes — we produce a rotation manifest including DEK id, old rewrap hash, new rewrap hash, who initiated, and timestamp. we can sign that manifest with our signing key and optionally encrypt it for the customer's public key. example manifest fields: `dek_id`, `old_kek_thumbprint`, `new_kek_thumbprint`, `rotation_ts`, `operator`.

Sam: vuln triage question they added in slack — they want SLA on triage for CVE scores >=9.0 and a timeline for mitigations. what do we commit publicly vs in an enterprise contract?

Maria: we usually say public SLA is 72h initial triage for criticals, private contracts can specify faster. we should propose 48h triage + weekly mitigation updates for Zephyrus in the call.

Olivia: also note data residency — for Private deployments we can keep logs entirely on-prem. include the config snippet for log export (they asked for example):

```
logging:
  export:
    type: s3
    bucket: zephyrus-audit
    path: /redwood/tenants/zephyrus
    encryption: AES256
```

Jake: one edge case: if customer rotates KEK frequently during migration we need to throttle rewrap jobs to avoid load spikes. add guidance: limit to 5 rewraps/hour per tenant or use a staged backlog.

Maria: who can own producing the signed attestation bundle? i’ll stitch the answers into the questionnaire template.

Rohit: I’ll prepare the KMS attestation doc + rotation manifest example.

Olivia: I’ll prepare sample exported logs (redacted) and the export command for Private.

Jake: I’ll produce RBAC changelog samples and the signed changelog process + sample GPG/OpenSSL verification command.

Sam: i'll draft the vuln triage SLA language and attach our standard mitigation cadence + contact points.

sec-bot: Reminder — attach runbook: https://internal.redwood/sec/playbooks/kms-rotation and the incident response matrix.

Maria: perfect. can we have drafts by EOD so i can pack into the evidence zip? also want a 1-page slide for the call. 09:30 PT tomorrow. :thumbsup:
